craft_notes: Sthāyin: promise-joy (the turn to telling). Rows: row 3 (most-hidden vs told — antithesis across break). Rupture: dash after one — reserved, then avowed. Close: proclaimed (not proven — kept). Minimal pass: none. Read aloud: hiding... yet — PROclaimed. Rejected: 'reveal' — killed: tell kept (kath); 'hidden well' alliterative — killed: worthy kept.

lines: Most worthy of hiding, fortunate one —
yet will I tell you: all Bhairava's form, proclaimed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam

reads_against.argmap: What will Bhairava tell? → What is most hidden will be proclaimed — the telling begins anyway.
c1_essence: Most hidden, yet told: the whole form of Bhairava.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with jijñāsā (wonder sharpened into seeking)
